notes.text: Search: an older hit (beyond the newest 500 mails of its folder) opened the folder list instead of the mail; the same for mails opened from "What's new?"
Search: a query that is only a time hint ("damals", "back then") no longer lists all mails
Pairing without the code uses the safer protocol of NovaBird Helper 0.5.2 and needs that version; confirm with "Number matches" after comparing. Pairing with the code works with every Helper
